book.name: 1 Kolin
book.title: 1 Kolin Pâlaŋ Kolin am ekŋengat zapat meluwaŋ ŋeŋaŋ kapi kumindaye

content: Dapmelaŋge ekŋengalen an ŋeŋaŋ bembe ekŋen Kawawaŋgalen mulup an

Kilaismagen notnne, neŋ inmagen koti am Emetak Teŋaŋ indadamuŋ mme mamaip ekŋengat zet diindondoyelen keyet kataŋ ku diindowan. Ingat ŋoktikŋin am msat kapiyelen sepem keboŋ ma in Kilaisiyelen buŋam zapat ku nâwien keyepmti neŋ ingat okak ekŋengat zet zewaknok zewan.
Neŋ meu katikŋaŋ ku indawan, belak nam etaŋ indama nimbien ma meu katikŋaŋ zigok nimbiek? Enenogat kan pigogak in meu katikŋaŋ niniyelen kataŋ ewe ku beip.

Alak in am Emetak Teŋaŋ indadamuŋ mme mamaipnok ewe ku mamaip. Ingat ŋoktikŋin am msat kapiyelen sepem keboŋ nâmti pepet ma atindândândâ tuŋguwinan mti am nâmkiŋpepeŋinpiŋ ekŋenaŋ mti maip sakam kegok tapmip.
In pigok tazeip, “Neŋ Pâliyelen am,” ma “Neŋ Apolosiyelen am.” Kegok tazeip keyaŋ zeinen in am msat kapiyelen nemboŋ beip.

Apolos ma neŋ nit kwiyepm in nigat egegalen am manzeip? Nit mulup an etaŋaŋ belak Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ diindomalu in Kilais nâmkiŋpewien. Keyet kataŋ Amobotnaŋaŋ mulup ikŋaŋgat kwep kwep zemndeyenok mbelin.
Neŋ alikŋaŋ katnaŋ etaŋ onzewan. Âpme Apolos egaŋ kegogak nusiŋaŋ etaŋ mge. Âpme Kawawaŋaŋ ikŋaŋ mme penaŋaŋ sokbeye.
Keyepm an katnaŋ ondeye ma nusiŋaŋ mge keyaŋ mulup omba penaŋ mge ŋep ku zenzeyelen. Kawawaŋaŋ mme penaŋaŋ masokbeingapmti egaŋ mulup omba mamgulak ŋep zenzeyelen.
Maondeme mozin ma nusiŋaŋ mamin an eget ke sepemit kwep. Yaŋgut mulup mimiŋit daŋgat kataŋ tosaŋaŋgulak ikŋak ikŋak tiwalup.
Nit belak Kawawaŋ mukulem mimiŋaŋ anenet mme in Kawawaŋgalen mulupmaŋgalen msat nemboŋ. Kogogak in Kawawaŋgalen mka nemboŋ nit tawalalup.

Kawawaŋaŋ keŋ taolet mnamti nânâ naŋge kataŋ neŋ mka walalalaŋ taŋkawat kaliŋaŋ pema towege. Âpme timbilaŋge ilak mpepeŋaŋ keyet palen amnaŋ mka penaŋ tusumti tawalatmolip keyepm am ekŋen keyaŋ weyaŋ nâmâtâtati walapbep.
Kawawaŋaŋ Zisas Kilais amnaŋ mka timbilaŋge mampeipnok bempeye. Zisas Kilais ek am nâmkiŋpepeŋinmak ekŋengalen mka timbilaŋgeŋaŋ keyepmti an ŋenaŋ asekti timbilaŋge alakŋaŋ mimiyelen sakam yek.
Âpme mka timbilaŋge mpepeŋaŋ keyet am notnaŋaŋ tusumti gol ma silwa ma nanzaŋ tosaŋaŋ temaŋ ma tep ma mgek ma puŋ kawaseŋ keboŋaŋ walamobep.

Kan temaŋgat Zisas kobe keyet muluwinaŋgat yaŋaŋ tewaŋ zimti mka butnaŋ kwep keyet kwiyaŋ katikŋaŋ ma bakŋaŋ walalatnaŋ keyet penaŋaŋ msokbewe. Mka keyet palen tep temaŋ zimti tewaŋ mka mulup mimiŋaŋ keyet yaŋaŋ msokbewenok am kwep kwepgalen kegogak mbe.
Âpme an ŋenaŋ mulupmaŋ mka timbilaŋge mpepeŋaŋnok keyet palaŋan walage ke tewaŋ zim alewe beme egaŋ keyet tosaŋaŋ tiwe.
Ma an ŋeniyelen mulupmaŋ ke tewaŋ zime delaŋ zemâbe beme mulupmaŋgat tosaŋaŋ ku tiwe. Âpme mka toŋaŋ ke zinziyelen bududuk penaŋ tapmeŋgut Kilaisiyaŋ an ikŋaŋ ke etaŋ aŋgalaŋpewe.
In Kawawaŋgalen sesewat mka ma Kawawaŋgalen Emetak Teŋaŋ ingat tuŋguwinan mamain. In kegok nâmtalip ma yek?
Kawawaŋgalen sesewat mka ke ikŋaŋgalen etaŋ. Sesewat mka ke dapmelaŋge in kemak. Keyepmti am ŋenaŋ Kawawaŋgalen dapmelaŋge sesewat mka nemboŋ ke walebe beme Kawawaŋaŋ kegogak an ke waletpewe.

In keŋ otnânâŋin ku tetipewep. Inmagengatnaŋ ŋenaŋ nâme ŋoktikŋaŋmak bewe beme egaŋ am msat kapiyelen ekŋenaŋ maotnâit sepem keboŋ. Egaŋ ikŋaŋ ŋoktikŋaŋmak ku nâwe. Egaŋ kogok peme tapme Zisas nâmkiŋpewe keyaŋ mme ŋoktikŋaŋmak penaŋ bewe.
Enenogat msalengalen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋgalen ŋoktik keboŋ ke Kawawaŋaŋ nâme belakŋaŋ penaŋ mambein. Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋaŋ meluwaŋ ŋen kapigok mimiŋaŋ tazin,

content.text: “Egaŋ am ŋoktikŋin temaŋ ekŋenaŋ kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ tetimae palen tapmme Kawawaŋaŋ ke timti aŋkapipilinok ompeme indowe.” (Zop 5:13)

content: Ma ŋen ewe kapigok zenzeŋaŋ,

content.text: “Amobotnaŋ egaŋ am nânâŋin temaŋ ekŋengalen zet nâme belakŋaŋ etaŋ mambein.” (Sam 94:11)

content: Keyepmti nin ingat an ŋeŋaŋin tapmanup kalaŋ kumndemti, “Neŋ ekmak talap,” zemti sek mmobot palen ku mambep. Yaŋgut kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ sambe ke ilinaŋgalen zapat:
Neŋ ma Apolos ma Kepas nin ingalen zapat mamanup ma msat kululuŋ ma wenzim eyoŋga talip ma gakiki ma alik mama pigogat wein ma bam wemobe ke ingat zapat bein.
Ma in Kilais egat zapat mambeip âpme Kilais egaŋ naman Kawawaŋgat zapat bein.
